scope: native mocked ESP UART/AT/TCP framing and recovery; no board or model quality measurement

tests.duplex: PASS_NETWORK_DUPLEX microphone CIPSEND progresses with continuous IPD; all incoming and outgoing bytes exact
tests.send_recovery: PASS_NETWORK_SPEECH_RECOVERY checks=3914 interrupted binary CIPSEND resynchronizes before TLS retry
tests.passive_receive: PASS_NETWORK_SPEECH_PASSIVE checks=134994 52507 binary bytes, bounded receive priority, short SSL reads fully drain, rejected uploads and empty reads recover
tests.receive_first: PASS_NETWORK_SPEECH_PASSIVE checks=91053 52507 binary bytes, bounded receive priority, short SSL reads fully drain, rejected uploads and empty reads recover
tests.zero_plaintext_read: PASS_NETWORK_SPEECH_NO_LENGTH checks=89151 52507 exact bytes, short reads, transient/empty errors, lost notifications and close recovery; zero encrypted-length queries
tests.raw_tls: PASS_NETWORK_TLS_RAW verified single SSL, exact full duplex, close recovery and host quiesce
tests.arm_tcp: PASS_NETWORK_ARM_TCP no ESP SSL, exact full duplex, close recovery and host quiesce
tests.framing_recovery_1m: PASS_NETWORK_FRAMING_RECOVERY latched error 1946, rebooted 115200 peer and corrupt AT line recover through verified serial/TLS reset
tests.framing_recovery_921600: PASS_NETWORK_FRAMING_RECOVERY latched error 1946, rebooted 115200 peer and corrupt AT line recover through verified serial/TLS reset
tests.recover_1m: PASS_WIFI_RECOVER fast/slow peers, volatile reset, verified baud, silent/wrong-speed/stuck-TX failures bounded
tests.recover_921600: PASS_WIFI_RECOVER fast/slow peers, volatile reset, verified baud, silent/wrong-speed/stuck-TX failures bounded
